Hi Mina —

Thanks for the clear summary and attachments. Quick answers inline:

- Service account roles: Create a dedicated service account with the "Grafana Cloud Receiver Ingest" role (we'll provide the policy snippet). Avoid using broad admin roles. We can support an IAM role with a limited token that only accepts OTLP/log batches.

- IP allowlist: Not strictly required if your forwarder uses TLS to Grafana endpoints, but some customers opt to restrict egress. If you want allowlisting, use the endpoints documented here: https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/logs/receivers/#endpoints

- Batching/compression: We recommend gzip for high-throughput logs and max batch size of ~1MB. For OTLP traces/metrics you can tune independently.

- Example receiver config: we reviewed your otlp-sample-config.yaml; minor tweaks suggested in the attached snippet (we also attached a short JSON policy for the service account).

Action items we can take on our side:
1) Send the exact IAM policy snippet (attaching grafana-service-account-template.txt).
2) Provision a temporary test tenant for end-to-end validation (if you can share the test dataset and a window).

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min joint test with Observian later this week.

Best,
Sarah Lim
Integrations Lead — Grafana Cloud
